evals.name: ai-content-stakeholders
evals.prompt: I'm preparing for stakeholder interviews about our decision to add AI-generated content summaries to our news app. The CTO loves it, the editorial team is worried, and users haven't been asked. Design a critical interview protocol that surfaces implicit values and power dynamics behind each group's position.
evals.expected_output: Interview protocol with role-specific question sets that surface implicit values, power dynamics, and assumptions, with probing follow-ups designed to elicit honest responses.

evals.name: workplace-surveillance
evals.prompt: Design a critical interview guide for talking to three groups about a new employee productivity tracking tool: managers who requested it, employees who will be tracked, and HR who must implement it. I need questions that surface what each group really thinks vs. what they'll say publicly.
evals.expected_output: Three separate interview guides with warm-up, core, and probing questions that distinguish public positions from private concerns, with attention to power asymmetry.

evals.name: algorithmic-hiring-bias
evals.prompt: Our AI hiring tool was found to score candidates from certain zip codes lower. I need to interview the data science team, the recruiting team, and affected candidates. Help me design critical interview protocols that don't put anyone on the defensive but still surface accountability.
evals.expected_output: Sensitively designed protocols that surface systemic issues without blame, with specific techniques for interviewing across power differentials.
